name: labs/festo-se__festo-dev-applied-motion
title: Festo FPosBAPI gantry (FPosBAPIClient)
intro: Festo FPosBAPI gantry (FPosBAPIClient), adapted from festo-se/festo-dev-applied-motion. It reads `position`, `sys_status`, `error_active`, `error_text` and 1 more; sets `global_speed`; runs `home`, `cartesian_pose` and `stop`. `home`: home all axes with one PLC HOME command; the PLC homes X, Y and Z together. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
